R305: The modeled usable capacity is 80% for LFP (20–100%), 85% for sodium-ion (15–100%), and 50% for lead-acid (50–100%). In this model, LFP and sodium-ion require fewer replacements over 20 years than lead-acid. Standard voltage settings for LFP limit sodium-ion to about 85% of nominal capacity; the shallower depth of discharge supports a longer cycle life. Lead-acid is limited to the upper half; with heavy discharge, the usable capacity further decreases. Weather data from {startYear} to {endYear} show when power from the grid or a generator would be needed.
